---
title: "Course Plan Browser — Observable JS proof of concept"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    toc: false
execute:
  echo: false
---

A static, no-server alternative to the Shiny `course_browser`: it loads the
**deduplicated, anonymized** course plans straight into the browser (no R/webR runtime
to boot) and does live full-text search over them entirely client-side.

The text shown is the anonymized `course_plan` (PII removed), not the raw extracted text.
Search runs over every plan body, so it is a substring scan across ~12k plans on each
keystroke — fast enough here; DuckDB-WASM would be the upgrade if it ever feels sluggish.

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Quarto's bundled OJS stdlib (1.9.x) has no FileAttachment().parquet(), so read
// the Parquet via DuckDB-WASM, then materialize plain JS objects for client-side
// filtering/search. Number() guards against DuckDB returning counts as BigInt.
db = DuckDBClient.of({
  plans: FileAttachment("data/plans.parquet"),
  offerings: FileAttachment("data/offerings.parquet")
})

plans = Array.from(await db.query("SELECT * FROM plans"), r => ({
  plan_content_id: r.plan_content_id,
  institution: r.institution,
  Emnekode: r.Emnekode,
  Emnenavn: r.Emnenavn,
  year_from: Number(r.year_from),
  year_to: Number(r.year_to),
  n_offerings: Number(r.n_offerings),
  course_plan: r.course_plan
}))

offerings = Array.from(await db.query("SELECT * FROM offerings"), r => ({
  plan_content_id: r.plan_content_id,
  institution: r.institution,
  Emnekode_raw: r.Emnekode_raw,
  Emnenavn: r.Emnenavn,
  year: Number(r.year),
  semester: r.semester,
  status: r.status
}))
```

```{ojs}
institutions = ["(all)", ...Array.from(new Set(plans.map(d => d.institution))).sort()]

yearExtent = [
  plans.reduce((m, d) => Math.min(m, d.year_from), Infinity),
  plans.reduce((m, d) => Math.max(m, d.year_to), -Infinity)
]

viewof inst = Inputs.select(institutions, {label: "Institution"})
viewof minYear = Inputs.range(yearExtent, {step: 1, value: yearExtent[0], label: "Plan active in / after"})

prefiltered = plans.filter(d =>
  (inst === "(all)" || d.institution === inst) && d.year_to >= minYear
)

viewof hits = Inputs.search(prefiltered, {
  placeholder: "Søk i emneplaner … (kode, navn eller innhold)",
  columns: ["Emnekode", "Emnenavn", "course_plan"],
  label: "Full-text search"
})
```

```{ojs}
md`**${plans.length}** unique plans · **${prefiltered.length}** after filters · **${hits.length}** match search`
```

:::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-6}
```{ojs}
viewof picked = Inputs.table(hits, {
  columns: ["institution", "Emnekode", "Emnenavn", "year_from", "year_to", "n_offerings"],
  header: {
    institution: "Inst",
    Emnekode: "Code",
    Emnenavn: "Name",
    year_from: "From",
    year_to: "To",
    n_offerings: "#Off"
  },
  width: {Emnenavn: 220},
  rows: 16,
  multiple: false,
  required: false
})
```
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-6}
```{ojs}
usedBy = picked ? offerings.filter(o => o.plan_content_id === picked.plan_content_id) : []

picked
  ? html`
      <h3 style="margin-bottom:0.1rem">${picked.Emnekode} — ${picked.Emnenavn ?? ""}</h3>
      <p style="color:#666; margin-top:0">
        ${picked.institution} · plan active
        ${picked.year_from}${picked.year_to !== picked.year_from ? "–" + picked.year_to : ""}
        · used by ${usedBy.length} offering${usedBy.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}
      </p>
      <div style="white-space:pre-wrap; border-top:1px solid #ddd; padding-top:0.6rem;
                  max-height:72vh; overflow:auto; font-size:0.92rem; line-height:1.45">${picked.course_plan}</div>`
  : html`<p style="color:#888"><em>Select a row to read its anonymized course plan.</em></p>`
```
:::
